known_boundaries: No external provider/database adapter is implied by this release.
No CrownThrive IO frontend deployment is implied by the portal descriptor alone.
Hosted repository assurance execution remains separately evidenced.
Serialization does not manufacture authority, rights, provider deployment, release permission, or legal sufficiency.
changelog: Introduced PentaSerialized as CrownThrive serialization and anti-erasure control plane.
Added stable artifact identity, SHA-256 revision/event lineage, append-only ledger and current-state projection.
Added expected-revision stale-write protection and semantic idempotency.
Added Git continuity receipts for deletions, renames and protected canonical mutations.
Added structural adapters for PentaVersion, PentaFormat, PentaSOPs, PentaSLAs and PentaScribe.
Wired PentaSnapshot, PentaRollback, PentaPR, PentaMerge, PentaRelease, PentaStatus and PentaGeneration contracts.
